messages:
Laura (Design): sharing updated mocks for the batch embeddings + rerank inspector. focus: toolbar wording, export CSV columns, and keyboard flow. quick screenshots in thread (link). Mike (Eng): skimmed — nice. main question: do we keep 'Relevance' as the primary column header or change to 'Rerank score'? the term affects sorting semantics. Sarah (PM): prefer 'Rerank score' — product folks read as a numeric signal. but in hover we should say 'Higher = more relevant'. small copy tweak. Laura (Design): ok fine. suggestion: header = 'Rerank score' and tooltip = 'Higher values mean the model ranks the item higher for this query'. shorter copy options in this thread please. Toni (A11y): small accessibility nit: the toolbar dropdowns are not keyboard tabbable in the prototype. need proper focus states and aria-expanded on the button. also the preview list items need role="listitem" and a skip-to-preview link for screen reader users. Ashok (DevEx): noted. for the skip link, do we show it only when keyboard detected? we usually render it visually-hidden but focusable. Toni (A11y): yes render visually-hidden and reveal on :focus. also confirm keyboard users can open item actions with Enter and close with Escape. aria-live region (polite) please. Mike (Eng): implementation detail: current table uses virtualized rows (react-window). adding role/list semantics may require wrapper changes. I can do the aria wrappers but need the exact tree you want. Laura, can you paste the intended DOM in one-liner? Laura (Design): roughly:
  • [preview card]
    • ...
Ashok (DevEx): CSV/export columns: what do we include? current mock includes: id, text, embedding vector (as base64), rerank_score, original_batch_id. do we need the full vector or a shortened representation? big vectors blow up CSV size. Sarah (PM): for exports used by customers, include vector_length and vector_checksum, not full vector by default. add a 'download full vectors' toggle. margin for privacy: we need to flag when vectors contain PII. Laura (Design): will update mock: default CSV columns = id, snippet, rerank_score, original_batch_id, vector_length. hover tooltip on 'Export' button: 'Download current view as CSV. Use "full vectors" for the complete data (may be large)'. Mike (Eng): one more: sort affordances — clicking header sorts asc/desc, but we should show a subtle chevron and 'aria-sort' attribute. ensure screen reader announces current sort. Toni (A11y): confirm: aria-sort="ascending|descending|none" on the THs. also live region on sort change: "Sorted by Rerank score, descending". I can propose exact strings. Toni (A11y): proposed live copy: "Results sorted by {column}, {direction}." keep it short. Sarah (PM): copy tweak: change 'snippet' to 'Excerpt' in UI. feels clearer when exporting. also the toolbar button label: 'Export results' -> 'Download results' (CTA consistency with other consoles). Laura (Design): updated labels: header 'Rerank score', snippet -> Excerpt, Export -> Download results. will attach revised PNG. Ashok (DevEx): telemetry: add an event 'download_results' with properties {view: "batch_rerank", columns: [...], full_vectors: bool} so we can measure usage. sending spec in a follow-up. Mike (Eng): dev note: when full_vectors=true we should stream compressed file (gz) to avoid memory spikes. deploy-bot: new message created for design review: https://redwood.app/design/threads/1891239876 Laura (Design): any remaining nits? if not i'll mark this as 'design-approved' and push to figma. Sarah (PM): looks good to me, approve from product. :white_check_mark: Toni (A11y): approve once dev implements aria-live + focusable skip link. will recheck in PR. Ashok (DevEx): approve pending telemetry and export gz streaming. Mike (Eng): will take implementation. thanks all. Laura (Design): great — thanks! I'll update the figma copy and upload final assets."
